markets.rules_primary: If the President of the United States has taken any executive action in 2026 imposing tariffs specifically on foreign-made films, where the executive action must explicitly reference foreign-made films in its title, operative text, or fact sheet (not merely in an attached tariff schedule annex) and set an effective date, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: This market resolves based on the issuance of an executive action, independent of the effective date or whether the tariffs are subsequently implemented. The qualifying action must be of the specific type designated (executive order, presidential memorandum, proclamation, directive, determination, or finding), be signed by the President personally during the specified time period, and explicitly address the topic in the document's operative provisions, title, or official White House summary. Actions must have legal or policy effect - ceremonial proclamations without policy impact do not qualify unless specifically included. Actions that only incidentally mention the topic, statements without formal action, actions by cabinet members, legislative proposals without executive action, and signing statements do not qualify. The action must be publicly announced or documented by a Source Agency before expiration.
markets.title: Will Trump issue any executive action on imposing tariffs specifically on foreign-made films, where the executive action must explicitly reference foreign-made films in its title, operative text, or fact sheet (not merely in an attached tariff schedule annex) during in 2026?

markets.rules_primary: If Angela Alsobrooks votes for a crypto market structure bill (as defined in KXCRYPTOSTRUCTURE) in the Senate before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: The vote must be the first final vote on the bill, not a motion to proceed or motion to invoke cloture, unless otherwise specified. This must be a vote in the relevant full chamber, not a Committee vote, though not every member of the chamber needs to have participated in the vote. Once the vote has been closed and the correct result of the vote has been announced, a request by the member to add, remove, or alter a vote shall not be considered for purposes of resolving this market, regardless of any change to the official vote tally reported by the website Congress.gov or any other Congressional source.

markets.rules_secondary:
An "official announcement" means a statement by the person themselves, their authorized representative, or the official body governing the office that the person will be departing from the office. Such announcements must be reported by at least one Source Agency to be considered official. The announcement must not specify they are leaving in more than a year from the statement, in which case the market does not resolve to Yes.

"Leaving office" means the person no longer holds the office in any capacity, including but not limited to: resignation (effective), termination, removal, impeachment and removal, recall, or the expiration of their term without renewal. Temporary absences such as medical leave, suspension with possibility of return, or delegation of duties while retaining the office do NOT constitute leaving office. Forced departures (termination, impeachment and removal, etc.) satisfy the Payout Criterion even without a prior announcement.
markets.subtitle: Yes

markets.rules_secondary:
This market will resolve to No if the FDA's decision is a denial (CRL issued), a withdrawal by the sponsor, or a conditional approval — or if no decision is issued. 

Saroglitazar (sold under the brand name Lipaglyn in India) is an oral small-molecule drug developed by Zydus Therapeutics that is designed to simultaneously activate two molecular switches in the body — called PPAR-alpha and PPAR-gamma — which together regulate how the body handles fats and sugars. Think of it like a dual-dial thermostat for metabolism: turning up both dials at once aims to reduce harmful lipid buildup and improve insulin sensitivity more effectively than nudging just one dial. In the EPICS-III trial, it is being evaluated as a treatment for primary biliary cholangitis, a liver disease distinct from its original metabolic indications.

markets.rules_secondary:
If the person leaves the role due to death (i.e., if the person dies while holding the role), all contracts on the person may resolve to the last fair price as determined in the sole discretion of the Exchange. Temporary leaves of absence, suspensions, or recusals do not constitute leaving, resigning from, or retiring from the role unless the individual formally and permanently ceases to hold the position. If the person vacates the role and then re-occupies the role, the contract may settle on the initial vacation of the role. If the role otherwise ceases to exist with no plausible successor, the contract may resolve to "No."

For "leave," cessation of holding the role qualifies, including resignation, retirement, removal, expulsion, expiration of term without renewal, recall, or other means by which the individual no longer occupies the role—this includes both voluntary and involuntary early departure AND the natural expiration of a term.

markets.rules_secondary:
Official diplomatic recognition may include, but is not limited to:

A formal announcement by the recognizing country that it recognizes the recognized country as a sovereign state
Establishment of diplomatic relations at the ambassadorial level
Opening of an embassy or diplomatic mission (not just consulates)
Signing of a joint communiqué establishing diplomatic relations
An official state visit by the head of state/government acknowledging sovereignty
A formal letter of recognition from the head of state/government or foreign minister

The following do NOT constitute recognition:

Trade relations or commercial agreements alone
Consular relations without diplomatic relations
Participation in the same international conference
Humanitarian assistance or aid
Cultural or educational exchanges
Recognition by subnational entities (states, provinces, cities)
Statements of "support" without formal recognition
De facto cooperation without formal recognition
Recognition conditional on future events that have not occurred
Parliamentary resolutions without executive action

For clarity: recognition must be of the recognized country as a sovereign state, not merely acknowledgment of a government in charge. Withdrawal of recognition from a competing entity is not required. Votes in UN bodies do not constitute recognition unless accompanied by bilateral recognition.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the law is enacted
markets.rules_primary: If legislation establishing a temporary citywide moratorium on both procuring and implementing new or expanded AI in Portland city government is enacted in Portland, Oregon before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Enactment requires completion of all constitutional and legal requirements for the legislation to become binding law. For an ordinance of the Portland City Council, that means final passage by the Council in the manner the City Charter and City Code require and the City Auditor's attestation; no separate executive approval is required. A delay in the effective date required by law, such as the 30-day delay after passage, does NOT prevent enactment.

To qualify, the legislation must prohibit both procuring and implementing new or expanded AI in city government. Legislation that prohibits only one of the two does NOT qualify. An inventory or reporting requirement alone does NOT qualify. Exemptions in the legislation, such as for existing contracts, approved pilots, incidental software and cybersecurity, do not prevent it from qualifying. The scheduled end date of the prohibition, and any amendment to it before final passage, does not affect whether it qualifies.

The following do NOT constitute enactment:

A proposal, hearing or first reading without final passage
Provisional, conditional or contingent passage subject to further legislative action not completed by the deadline
Non-binding resolutions
A measure referred to voters that has not been adopted

Enactment occurs when all requirements are completed, regardless of pending judicial challenges.
markets.title: Will Portland enact its AI pause in 2026?

events.title: Will Portland enact its AI pause in 2026?

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the visit occurs.
markets.rules_primary: If Pope Leo XIV has physically travelled to and been present within the geographic boundaries of Peru before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The following do NOT constitute a visit:

Flying over the area without landing
Layovers during which the person remains in an airplane
Virtual or remote appearances
Presence in international waters adjacent to the area
Presence solely within embassy or consulate grounds
Plans, announcements, or scheduling of future visits that do not occur during the applicable time period

For the avoidance of doubt, a visit occurs only when the person exits an aircraft, vehicle, vessel, or train within the area, or otherwise physically enters the area not aboard one. Remaining aboard, including during flyovers, drive-throughs, and non-exit refueling stops, does not constitute a visit. Exiting within the area constitutes a visit regardless of duration or method of exit.

markets.rules_primary: If Alex Cooper and Alix Earle have been seen together in public starting 10:00 AM Apr 14, 2026 and before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
All of the following criteria must be met:

Physical Presence: Alex Cooper and Alix Earle together is physically present (not virtual/holographic) and alive
Consciousness: Alex Cooper and Alix Earle together appears conscious and aware (not unconscious, comatose, or incapacitated)
Public Setting: The sighting occurs in one of the following:
   A public space accessible to the general public (streets, parks, shops, restaurants)
   A ticketed public event (concerts, sports events, conferences)
   An official public appearance (government events, ceremonies, press conferences)
   A semi-public venue where public access is normal (hotels, airports, train stations)

The following do NOT satisfy the Payout Criterion:

Pre-recorded or archival footage presented as current
Private events closed to the general public (private parties, closed meetings)
Medical facilities, private residences, or restricted areas
Virtual appearances (video calls, holograms, avatars)
Body doubles or impersonators
Corpses, funeral viewings, or posthumous footage

Examples that WOULD resolve to Yes:

Alex Cooper and Alix Earle together attends a movie premiere and is photographed on the red carpet by multiple Source Agencies
Alex Cooper and Alix Earle together gives a live press conference covered by news media
Alex Cooper and Alix Earle together attends a sporting event and is shown on the stadium's video screens

Examples that would NOT resolve to Yes:

Pre-recorded video message
Private party footage leaked online
Someone claiming to be Alex Cooper and Alix Earle together but without Source Agency confirmation
Alex Cooper and Alix Earle together appearing via video link from home
markets.title: Will Alex Cooper and Alix Earle be seen together in public before Jan 1, 2027?

markets.rules_primary: If the Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act of 2026 or other legislation containing its core permitting reforms has become law after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: The Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act of 2026 counts if enacted under that name, including as amended. Other legislation, including a renamed version or a larger bill such as a defense authorization or government funding bill, counts if all three of the Act's core permitting reforms become law, in one or more laws, after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2027: (1) deadlines for, or limits on judicial review of, environmental reviews under the National Environmental Policy Act; (2) limits on the federal government's ability to revoke, suspend or withdraw already-issued federal permits; and (3) new Federal Energy Regulatory Commission authority over the siting or cost allocation of interstate electric transmission lines.

markets.rules_primary: If the number of Representatives voting Yea on the Protect College Sports Act before Jan 1, 2027 is below 200, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The Protect College Sports Act means S. 4668 (119th Congress), including as amended and regardless of any change to its short title, or a House bill with the same short title. Only the first final House vote on passage counts.

The vote must occur in the relevant full chamber (that is, not a Committee vote, though not every member of the chamber needs to have participated in the vote). If no vote has occurred before the specified date, then any market not including "zero" within its count (e.g. "Between 50 and 64") resolves to No, and any market including "zero" (e.g. "Below 50") resolves to Yes. If the vote count is not specified but the bill is passed, any market including "100" for the Senate and "435" for the House of Representatives (e.g. "Between 65 and 100" or "Between 300 and 435") will resolve to Yes, and any market not including "100" or "435", respectively, (e.g. "Below 65") resolves to No.

Once the market has expired, a request by any Member of Congress to add, remove, or alter a vote shall not be considered for purposes of resolving this market, regardless of any change to the official vote tally reported by the website Congress.gov or any other official source.

Public statements or announcements of intent

The opening or continuation of an investigation
Passport actions
Proceedings Omar brings, even if the government contests her citizenship in them
Other criminal charges, including charges for later claims of citizenship such as passport or voting statements

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the function is implemented.
markets.rules_primary: If an OpenAI product has implemented a general-purpose personal AI agent that remembers the user and starts multi-step tasks across third-party apps on its own before Oct 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The function must be live and processing user interactions, not explicitly labeled as "beta," "test," "experimental," "preview," or "early access" or similar, and officially acknowledged by the company through announcements, documentation, or help pages. Implementation includes direct integration into the product's interface, automatic application to user accounts, user-initiated activation through official controls, API implementation, or policy changes that operationally enforce the function. Announcements without deployment, employee-only testing, technical documentation without implementation, and third-party additions without authorization do not qualify. The implementation must occur in the United States unless otherwise specified. If it meets these conditions, it counts from the first date it is live for users outside the company, including in a gradual rollout or a waitlist, invitation-only, or paid-tier release.

A general-purpose personal AI agent acts for an individual user on that user's own goals, is not limited to a single category of task or app, such as only code, only documents, or only shopping, and (1) retains user-specific information, such as preferences, relationships, goals, or ongoing activities, across separate interactions, and (2) as a built-in capability, on its own initiative and outside any conversation or task the user has started, begins new multi-step actions across third-party apps, websites, or services to advance the user's ongoing goals, based on what it has retained. The agent must itself take at least one such action before asking the user anything, and may then pause for approval before a step such as sending a message or making a purchase. An action means changing something in a third-party app, website, or service on the user's behalf, such as sending, posting, booking, purchasing, submitting a form, or creating, editing, or deleting an item; reading, searching, or summarizing does not count. An agent focused on work qualifies if it acts across email, calendar, messaging, and the web for an individual user.

The following do not qualify: carrying out a task the user started, however long-running; running tasks on a user-defined schedule, event trigger, or monitor, or under a standing instruction that tells the agent what to do or which app, source, or workflow to watch; a briefing or notification on its own; a proposed task or suggestion that does nothing until the user accepts it; an offer made in reply to the user's message; memory alone; an agent configured by an organization to run shared team workflows; and a developer platform, SDK, or API for building agents, unless the company itself offers through it an agent that meets (1) and (2) for end users. A goal or preference the user has shared, from which the agent itself decides what new task to start, is not a standing instruction, and neither is turning the capability on, connecting apps, or granting permissions.
markets.title: Will OpenAI release a personal AI agent before Oct 1, 2026?

markets.rules_primary: If the Delivery Protection Act (Int. 0518-2026, including amended versions of the bill) is enacted in New York City after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Enactment requires completion of all constitutional and legal requirements for the legislation to become binding law.

New York City legislation requiring executive approval: final passage by the Council, then the mayor signs the bill and returns it to the Council clerk, OR the bill becomes law despite mayoral inaction, OR the Council successfully overrides a veto, and satisfaction of any required waiting periods

Enactment occurs when all requirements are completed, regardless of pending judicial challenges. A law counts once enacted, even if it takes effect later.

The market resolves based on the value of the Nikkei 225 as reported by the Trading View, using the index's natively published level in its own currency and units; no currency conversion is applied. It is sufficient for the index to reach or exceed ¥73,000 at any single point from Jun 16, 2026 to Dec 31, 2026 for the market to resolve to Yes — the level does not need to be sustained. markets.rules_primary: If the NHL officially announces the award of an expansion team franchise to Houston before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: The league must officially announce that the city has been awarded an expansion franchise. This requires formal approval by the league's Board of Governors or equivalent governing body specifically naming the city. Preliminary discussions, stadium approvals without franchise awards, feasibility studies, or being named as a potential market do not qualify. Franchise relocations only count if specifically designated as "expansion" by the league. The announcement must come after market issuance. Even if the team won't begin play until after the target date, the market resolves Yes upon the official award announcement. Awards to nearby cities in the same region only count if they specifically include the named city or its metropolitan area.

markets.rules_primary: If the National Guard is deployed to Chicago after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Deployment means National Guard members arrive in Chicago on official deployment orders, under State Active Duty (SAD), Title 32, or Title 10 activation, for operational missions (not routine training), with actual presence in Chicago, not merely assigned or in transit.

The following constitutes deployment and resolves YES:

Governor activates Guard with deployment to Chicago
Guard units arrive in Chicago on emergency orders
Federal activation placing Guard in Chicago
Inter-state Emergency Management Assistance Compact (EMAC) deployment to Chicago
Pre-positioned Guard units activated for operations in Chicago
Any number of Guard members (even one) officially deployed

The following does NOT constitute deployment and resolves NO:

Deployment announcements without actual arrival
Guard placed on standby/alert status only
Units staged outside Chicago without entering
Training exercises or routine drills
Guard members traveling through Chicago to another destination
Planning/assessment teams without follow-on deployment
Off-duty Guard members acting as civilians
Guard at permanent facilities (armories) not on deployment orders
Recruitment or community relations activities
Canceled deployments that never materialize

Special provisions:

At least one Guard member must physically arrive in Chicago.
Deployment must be for operational purposes, not training.
If deployment is announced then canceled before arrival, resolves NO.
Presence for transit only doesn't count.
Re-deployment of already-present units to new locations within Chicago counts only if they were not previously on deployment orders.
Both Army National Guard and Air National Guard deployments count.
Federal military (non-Guard) deployments do not count.

markets.rules_primary: If at least 25 persons have received Neuralink brain-computer interface implants before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Only unique human individuals count toward the total, regardless of how many devices each person receives. If one person receives multiple implants or device replacements, they count as one person.

Cumulative totals include all persons who have ever received a Neuralink implant, including those who may have had devices removed, experienced device failure, or are deceased. Only successful implantations count; attempted implantations that are aborted during surgery (and thus not actually implanted) do not count.

The implantations need not occur after Issuance to count toward 25.

For the purposes of this contract, Neuralink brain-computer interface implants include the following:

The N1 chip system and any successor devices developed by Neuralink
Devices surgically implanted in the brain or nervous system designed to record neural activity and/or stimulate neural tissue
Both fully functional and partially functional implanted devices
Devices implanted for medical treatment, research, or enhancement purposes

The following do NOT count as Neuralink implants:

External devices, headsets, or non-implanted brain-computer interfaces
Devices developed by other companies, even if similar in function
Neuralink devices implanted in animals
Theoretical, planned, or projected implant numbers without confirmation of actual procedures

If Neuralink merges with a different company or changes its name, the Contract will continue to track the successor entity.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the event occurs.
markets.rules_primary: If any federal or state court issues a temporary restraining order or a preliminary or permanent injunction barring enforcement of Montana Initiative 194 (2026), or declares it invalid or unenforceable, in whole or in part in Frontier Institute v. Knudsen (D. Mont.), any appeal of that action, or any other action challenging Initiative 194's validity before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The ruling must:
Be issued by any federal or state court in Frontier Institute v. Knudsen (D. Mont.), any appeal of that action, or any other action challenging Initiative 194's validity
Address the matter described by the specified judgment
Be issued through a written order, opinion, judgment, or decision

Partial relief counts. A written temporary restraining order, preliminary injunction, or permanent injunction, or a written judgment declaring Initiative 194 invalid or unenforceable, qualifies even if it covers only part of Initiative 194 or applies only to certain plaintiffs, activities or provisions, and even if it is interim or limited in scope. A qualifying ruling counts when issued, even if it is later stayed, vacated, or reversed.

Montana's agreement or promise not to enforce Initiative 194 does not qualify unless a court enters it as a written order barring enforcement.

The following do NOT satisfy the Payout Criterion:
Oral rulings from the bench unless reduced to a written order
Tentative rulings that are not made final
Draft opinions that leak but are not officially issued
Settlements or voluntary dismissals
Administrative or scheduling orders
Orders to show cause
Minute orders that do not address the substantive issue in the specified judgment

For clarity:
If the case is dismissed for lack of jurisdiction, that counts as a ruling only if the judgment refers to jurisdiction
Sua sponte rulings count if they match the specified judgment
Per curiam opinions and summary orders count as rulings
If multiple judges issue separate opinions, the majority/plurality opinion controls

markets.rules_primary: If Friedrich Merz and Vladimir Putin meet (including phone calls) after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
A meeting is defined as any of the following:

An in-person encounter where both parties are physically present in the same location
A virtual meeting via video conference where both parties can see and hear each other in real-time
A phone call where both parties speak directly to each other
Any combination of the above where the parties interact directly in real-time

The following qualify as meetings (though this list is not exhaustive):

Formal bilateral meetings, summits, or conferences
Informal encounters at multilateral events if documented by Source Agencies
Working dinners, lunches, or other meal meetings
Pull-aside meetings or corridor conversations if documented
Home visits or meetings at non-official locations

The following do NOT qualify as meetings:

Being present at the same event without direct interaction
Exchanging written correspondence
Communication through intermediaries without direct contact
Pre-recorded messages or asynchronous communication
Meetings cancelled after being scheduled
Near-misses where parties were scheduled to meet but did not

markets.early_close_condition: This market may close and expire early after an eligible initial BLS publication exceeds its threshold. A below-threshold publication does not end the market. Otherwise, the outcome is evaluated after the eligibility window ends.
markets.rules_primary: If the Producer Price Index by Commodity: Lumber and Wood Products: Softwood Lumber (BLS series WPU0811; not seasonally adjusted; index 1982=100) is above 190 index points in any eligible initial monthly publication released strictly after this market's actual first issuance and before January 1, 2027 at 12:00 AM EST, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The source is the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS). The exact statistic is Producer Price Index by Commodity: Lumber and Wood Products: Softwood Lumber, series WPU0811, not seasonally adjusted, index 1982=100. Values are index points, not dollar lumber prices. FRED (https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/WPU0811) republishes this BLS series; the BLS publication time and original value control.

For each market, the eligibility window begins strictly after that market's actual first issuance and ends strictly before January 1, 2027 at 12:00 AM EST. A publication already released at or before issuance does not count, including a release earlier on listing day. A subsequently added market has its own issuance time. The observation month may precede issuance: eligibility is determined by publication time.

Use the initial BLS publication for each monthly observation, including a preliminary publication. This expressly selects initial publications instead of waiting for the first non-preliminary release. Subsequent revisions and corrections do not count. Publications at or after the deadline do not count, even if their observation month is in 2026. A current FRED chart containing revised history must not be used in place of the original release.

Above means strictly greater than the strike, using the BLS-reported precision without additional rounding. A qualifying publication permits early Yes settlement. If none exceeds the strike by the deadline, including when there are no eligible publications, the condition is not met and the market resolves to No, subject to the Contract's normal data-unavailability and market-outcome-review contingencies.

markets.rules_primary: If Kenya has agreed to, signed, or accepted a critical minerals agreement with the United States before Nov 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
An agreement also made with other countries (i.e. multilaterally) is still encompassed if Kenya participates. A qualifying agreement is a written agreement, memorandum of understanding, framework, or similar instrument between the government of Kenya and the government of the United States, including any U.S. federal department or agency, that is expressly described in its text or in either government's official announcement as concerning critical minerals or rare earth elements, including their exploration, mining, processing, refining, supply, purchase, or financing.

A preliminary agreement, agreement in principle, or memorandum of understanding qualifies; ratification, entry into force, and implementation are not required. Both governments publicly and officially agreeing to the terms of such an instrument is sufficient even if formal signing has not yet taken place.

An agreement that also covers other subjects qualifies if it includes such critical minerals terms. A contract, license, or project award between either government and a private company, without both governments as parties, does NOT qualify. Statements that negotiations are advanced or ongoing do NOT qualify. Joining, endorsing, or signing a declaration, communique, statement of principles, or membership in a multi-country forum or partnership, such as the Forum on Resource Geostrategic Engagement or the Minerals Security Partnership, does NOT qualify unless the instrument sets out critical minerals commitments specifically between Kenya and the United States. A grant, loan, financing commitment, technical-assistance, geological-survey, or data-sharing agreement for a single study or project does NOT qualify unless either government officially describes it as a critical minerals agreement, framework, or partnership between Kenya and the United States.
markets.title: Will Kenya and the US reach a critical minerals deal before Nov 1, 2026?

An involuntary termination is defined as:

● Termination for cause, including but not limited to performance issues, misconduct,
policy violations, or breach of employment agreement

● Termination without cause where ABC unilaterally ends the employment
relationship

● Dismissal, discharge, or removal from office by ABC or its governing body

● Non-renewal of an employment contract where ABC chooses not to extend the
relationship

● Removal by vote of no confidence, impeachment, or similar formal removal process

● Suspension pending termination that results in actual termination before Jan 1, 2027

● Coerced or involuntary resignation

markets.rules_primary: If Jensen Huang has physically travelled to and been present within the geographic boundaries of the White House after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The following do NOT constitute a visit:

Flying over the area without landing
Layovers during which the person remains in an airplane
Virtual or remote appearances
Presence in international waters adjacent to the area
Presence solely within embassy or consulate grounds
Plans, announcements, or scheduling of future visits that do not occur during the applicable time period

For the avoidance of doubt, a visit occurs only when the person exits an aircraft, vehicle, vessel, or train within the area, or otherwise physically enters the area not aboard one. Remaining aboard, including during flyovers, drive-throughs, and non-exit refueling stops, does not constitute a visit. Exiting within the area constitutes a visit regardless of duration or method of exit.

The White House means any of the following:

The Executive Residence
The West Wing
The East Wing
The Eisenhower Executive Office Building
All gardens, lawns, and outdoor spaces within the secured perimeter of the White House, including the Rose Garden and the South Lawn
markets.title: Will Jensen Huang visit the White House before Jan 1, 2027?

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the person announces their candidacy.
markets.rules_primary: If Hakeem Jeffries has announced that they will run for House Democratic leader for the 120th Congress in 2026 after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2027, including running for the nomination of any political party to contest that office, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The person must publicly announce their campaign for it to be reported by a Source Agency. Merely filing campaign paperwork with the Federal Election Commission or similar entity is insufficient without a public announcement. The announcement must be for the specific office and election year listed. Exploratory committees or statements of interest without formal campaign announcements do not qualify. Running for a party's nomination to contest the office counts as running for that office. The announcement must come from the person themselves or their official campaign, not from speculation or third-party sources.

House Democratic leader means the top post the House Democratic Caucus elects for the 120th Congress after the 2026 midterm elections: its nominee for Speaker of the House if Democrats win the House majority, or Minority Leader if they do not. An announcement made before the House majority is known, including a conditional one, counts only if it is for the post that becomes the top post. Running only for a lower post, such as Majority Leader or whip, does not count. Standing as a candidate in that leadership election after Issuance, including unopposed, counts as announcing a run. An announcement made before Issuance does NOT resolve Yes. For a person who announced before Issuance, repeating that announcement does not count; only standing as a candidate in that leadership election after Issuance resolves Yes. A person who announces and later withdraws still resolves YES.
markets.title: Will Hakeem Jeffries announce a run for House Democratic leader for the 120th Congress in 2026?

Changes in coalition composition that don't result in the prime minister's resignation do NOT count. This includes a party leaving the ruling coalition of the Netherlands, or withdrawing its ministers from the cabinet, while the prime minister stays on to lead the remaining parties.

An announcement that the government of the Netherlands will resign, including a resignation the cabinet offers to the King that has not yet been accepted, counts on the date it is announced.

custom_strike.Topic: the New York City Department of Education officially announces it will replace Google Search for its students with another search provider

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the event occurs.
markets.rules_primary: If the New York City Department of Education officially announces it will replace Google Search for its students with another search provider after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
A school district replaces Google Search for its students if it makes another search provider the default search engine for students across the district, on district-managed student devices or student accounts, or otherwise stops providing Google Search to its students in favor of another provider.
An official announcement by the district, its leadership or its board counts even if the switch takes effect on or after Jan 1, 2027. The announcement must be made after Issuance and reported before Jan 1, 2027.
The following do NOT count:
Saying the district will explore, consider or test another search provider without announcing a switch
Blocking or disabling AI features while keeping Google Search
Switching only some schools or grades, or a pilot
Losing access to Google Search without the district announcing a replacement
Each district is judged on its own, and action by a district not named in this event does not affect any market here.
Only reporting from a Source Agency qualifies for the purposes of this market. Reports that merely reference prior publications (from before Issuance) do not qualify. Republishing of content originally produced by other sources (e.g., wire services) only qualifies if the content is hosted on the outlet's official platform and the outlet is clearly identified as the publishing entity.

markets.rules_secondary:
The following do NOT constitute a visit:

Flying over the area without landing
Layovers during which the person remains in an airplane
Virtual or remote appearances
Presence in international waters adjacent to the area
Presence solely within embassy or consulate grounds
Plans, announcements, or scheduling of future visits that do not occur during the applicable time period

For the avoidance of doubt, a visit occurs only when the person exits an aircraft, vehicle, vessel, or train within the area, or otherwise physically enters the area not aboard one. Remaining aboard, including during flyovers, drive-throughs, and non-exit refueling stops, does not constitute a visit. Exiting within the area constitutes a visit regardless of duration or method of exit.
